paper_metadata.title: The microstructure, creep resistance, and high-temperature mechanical properties of Mg-5Sn alloy with Ca and Sb additions, and aging treatment

evidence.quote: The microstructure, creep resistance, and high-temperature shear strength of the Mg-5Sn, Mg-5Sn-1.4Ca, and Mg-5Sn-0.4Sb alloys were studied in the as-cast and aged conditions.
The three alloys used in this investigation were based on Mg-5 wt.% Sn with 0.4 Sb and 1.4 wt.% Ca additions.
High purity Mg, Sn, Ca and Sb were used to prepare the alloys.

mechanical properties and creep resistance of the aged alloys were much better than those of the as-cast materials, due to the higher volume fraction of Mg 2Sn, Mg 3 Sb2 , and CaMgSn precipitates distributed homogeneously in the microstructure of the aged materials.

This was attributed to the concurrent formation of Mg 2 Sn particles with the more thermally stable CaMgSn or Mg3 Sb2 phases which strengthen both matrix and grain boundaries during deformation in the investigated system.
